programs.title: Learn to Skate / Skating School
programs.description: Dover Arena skating school for beginners through advanced youth skaters. Session dates and levels are posted on the city recreation site. Confirm current season registration with the arena front desk.

offerings.label: Season registration
offerings.schedule_text: Fall, winter, and spring sessions — see official listing
offerings.registration_text: Register through Dover recreation / arena program pages or call (603) 516-6060.

programs.title: Women's Hockey / Chix With Stix
programs.description: Fun pick-up skate for adult women, ages 18 and older, with basic skating skills. This is a drop-in weekly skate. Advance sign-up required. Please bring a dark and light jersey to the skate.

offerings.label: Fall/Winter Session
offerings.registration_text: Sign-ups open Wednesday at 8 a.m. for the following week's skate by calling the front desk 603-516-6060.

offerings.label: Winter/Spring Session
offerings.registration_text: Sign-ups open Mondays at 8:00 a.m. for the following week's skate by calling the front desk (603) 516-6060. Must sign up in advance.

offerings.label: Summer Session
offerings.registration_text: Sign-ups open Wednesday at 8:00 a.m. for the following Tuesday's skate by calling the front desk (603) 516-6060. Must sign up in advance.

programs.title: Dover Arena Co-Ed Hockey League
programs.description: League focused on the intermediate hockey player, 18 and over, CO-ED. Eight-team league; players register individually and arena staff adjust rosters. Focus on fun, teamwork, and skill improvement. Strict discipline and tough play rules. Full equipment required. Non-contact, no slap shots. Registrations are limited and this program fills quickly.

offerings.label: Fall Session
offerings.registration_text: Current players have until Wednesday, September 16 to sign up before registration opens. Email Mike (mike.young@dover.nh.gov) for online registration information or mail a printed registration form with a check.

offerings.label: Winter/Spring Session
offerings.registration_text: Current players have until Tuesday, December 16 to sign up before registration opens. Email Mike (mike.young@dover.nh.gov) for online registration information or mail a printed registration form with a check.

offerings.label: Spring Session
offerings.registration_text: Current players have until Wednesday, March 4 to sign up before registration opens. Email Mike (mike.young@dover.nh.gov) for online registration information or mail a printed registration form with a check.

offerings.label: Summer Session
offerings.registration_text: Current players have until Friday, June 17 to sign up before registration opens. Email Mike (mike.young@dover.nh.gov) for online registration information or mail a printed registration form with a check.

programs.title: Co-ed / Beginner Level Pick-up Hockey
programs.description: Beginner hockey pickup for men and women ages 18 and over. Recreational program focused on skill enhancement and fun. Safe, non-contact; welcomes beginner and intermediate skaters who stay focused on a fun pick-up game. No strong intermediate or advanced skaters; advanced skaters may be asked to leave. Beginner hockey players only. Full hockey equipment required. Sessions are 1.5 hours. Two goalies provided.

offerings.label: Summer Session
offerings.times_text: Check times weekly – registrations open at 8:00 a.m. Monday for Friday's skate by calling the front desk (603) 516-6060
offerings.registration_text: Call the front desk to register each week.

offerings.label: Fall Session
offerings.times_text: Check times weekly – registrations open at 8:00 a.m. Monday for that week's skate by calling 603-516-6060
offerings.registration_text: Call the arena front desk each week.

offerings.label: Winter/Spring Session
offerings.times_text: Check times weekly – registrations open at 8:00 a.m. Monday for that week's skate by calling 603-516-6060
offerings.registration_text: Call the arena front desk each week.

programs.title: Beginner Adult Hockey Skills, Drills & Pick-up Games
programs.description: Beginner hockey skills program for men and women ages 18 and over. Recreational; skill enhancement and fun. Safe, non-contact; welcomes all beginner skaters. Men limited to beginner level only (no intermediate or advanced). Full hockey equipment required. In-season sessions are 1.5 hours; summer sessions are 50 minutes of skating with drills and a game at the end. Qualified adult hockey instructors on the ice each session.

offerings.label: Summer Session
offerings.registration_text: Drop-in program – call the front desk for registration details.

programs.title: Adult Intro Skills and Drills
programs.description: Designed for adult beginner skaters (men and women) 18+. Basic skating skills and drills related to hockey. Full hockey equipment required.
